english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 4(4) and 2(2) of the Midland Metro Systems Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes: A person who contravenes this byelaw shall be liable to pay a penalty fare payable to the operator - see byelaw 4(6) together with section 5(1) of the Midland Metro (Penalty Fares) Act 1991
